title: Shiva Shakthi
desc: Kartikeya persists in his determination and summons Goddess Parvati to disclose the identity of his father. Expressing his resentment, he condemns his father for abandoning him throughout the years.

title: Aswathama
desc: A man returns to India for his sister's engagement ceremony but discovers that something terrible has happened to her. On his quest for the truth, he uncovers a series of crimes against women.

title: Amrithadhare
desc: Puru and Amritha are a married couple deeply in love with each other. However, they face challenges as they try to balance their conflicting desires in their marriage.

title: Sarkari Haraju
desc: A man gets into a conflict with a powerful politician after he tries to retrieve a large sum of money that he has given to his fraudulent lover, who happens to be the latter's daughter.

title: Kotigobba 3
desc: After succeeding at framing ACP Kishore, Satya goes on to become an international criminal. While he gets targeted by Interpol, Kishore seeks revenge on him too, upon being released from prison.
